This 225m2 upper floor office at 145 on Blaauwberg, Table View, offers six separate offices, main road exposure and a MyCiTi bus stop directly outside. At R27,500 per month, it suits professional practices and businesses needing private workspaces with convenient public transport access.

Office Size: 225m2

Layout: Six separate offices

Fit out: Carpeted throughout, partially air conditioned

Parking: Not specified

Building Amenities: Prepaid electricity and signage opportunity

Access & Transport: Blaauwberg Road, R27 and MyCiTi bus service

Proximity to Landmarks: MyCiTi bus stop directly outside

Availability: Immediately

The partitioned layout supports businesses requiring private consultation rooms, team offices or dedicated administrative spaces. Its position on Blaauwberg Road provides street visibility, while direct MyCiTi access assists staff and clients travelling by public transport. The R27 connects Table View with surrounding West Coast business and residential areas, supporting daily commuting and client visits. This office is suited to consultancies, professional service firms, training businesses and established small companies seeking multiple private offices in an accessible Table View location.
